integrity: The analytic proof, exact sign-isolating intervals, strictly convex normalization, and a standalone supplementary verifier are included. Numerical checks are not substituted for infinite-domain proofs. Historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Analytic statement applies to a dimensionless, uncalibrated fixed-ratio two-band light-risk plus exponential depth-cost model; finite water column, food dynamics, predator visual responses and variable spectral ratios excluded. The claimed two-crest response is not an empirical observation.
title: Two-band optical risk permits exactly two crests of optimal refuge depth
